definition:
version: 1
language: python
files:
  - opportunity.py
  - decisions.py
fidelity: Best-effort
runtime: nle-runtime.json
decisions:
  admit:
    opportunity_pass:
      file: opportunity.py
      function: opportunity_pass
    feasibility_pass:
      file: decisions.py
      function: feasibility_pass
  select:
    file: decisions.py
    function: select
    policy_config:
       max_chances: 4
  rebalance:
    file: decisions.py
    function: rebalance
  extent:
    file: decisions.py
    function: extent
    policy_config:
      max_steps: 20
  predict:
    file: decisions.py
    function: predict
    policy_config:
      value_type: enum
      enum_values: ["moved", "blocked"]
  launch:
    file: decisions.py
    function: launch
  effect:
    file: decisions.py
    function: effect
  match:
    file: decisions.py
    function: match_proposal
    policy_config:
      value_type: enum
      enum_values: ["moved", "blocked"]
  dispose:
    file: decisions.py
    function: dispose
